title: Machine learning screened metal oxides for acetylene semihydrogenation
summary: A neural-network model was used to predict metal-oxide catalyst performance for acetylene semi-hydrogenation. The authors report experimental validation of predictions for CuO, ZnO and V2O5, and report 99.6% conversion with 90% ethylene selectivity for CuO under the abstract-described conditions. The entry is limited to the publisher abstract; detailed model validation, candidate selection and full assay context were not reviewed.
ai_technology: Neural-network prediction of metal-oxide catalyst performance

source_review.scope: Primary publisher abstract for identity, displayed date, model and reported experiment; official Zhejiang University of Technology faculty profile/publication list for named contributor affiliation. Full paper methods and supplement not reviewed.

evidence.tested: The publisher abstract says CuO, ZnO and V2O5 predictions were experimentally validated; it reports 99.6% conversion and 90% ethylene selectivity for CuO at 50–100°C.
evidence.unknown: Detailed selection chronology, model split/performance, full test conditions and results for ZnO and V2O5 were not established from the reviewed abstract. The date is the publisher-displayed date, not a claim of first public appearance.
evidence.ai_role: A neural-network model predicted catalyst performance and informed the metal-oxide candidates reported as experimentally validated.
